title: Environment Protection Authority (EPA), NSW
summary: This page provides information about the Environment Protection Authority (EPA) in NSW, including its functions and how to apply for an Environment Protection Licence.

external_links.text: Apply for a Environment Protection Licence – Environment Protection Authority (EPA)

internal_links.text: Planning, Housing and Infrastructure, NSW Department of

faqs.q: What is the Environment Protection Authority (EPA)?
faqs.a: The EPA is responsible for protecting the environment and managing pollution in NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for an Environment Protection Licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for an Environment Protection Licence through the EPA's dedicated licensing page.

faqs.q: Who manages planning and infrastructure in NSW?
faqs.a: The NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure manages these areas.
